description: Field recording beside the Torrente Pettorina at Boscoverde, near Rocca Pietore in the Belluno Dolomites, Italy. For this recording, the microphone was positioned laterally to the torrent but pointed toward the dense green vegetation along the bank. A cricket can be heard clearly among the bushes, while the continuous rush of the mountain stream remains behind it as a broad background layer. The change in microphone direction creates a different perspective from the other recordings in the series: less focused on the power of the water and more on the small ecosystem living beside it. Recorded with a Zoom H1essential — see if you can spot it hiding somewhere in the photo :)
name: Cricket in Riverside Bushes with Mountain Stream in the Background, Boscoverde - Torrente Pettorina
